_meta.description: X12 Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC) -> pipeline check-family mapping. CARCs are administrative codes from the X12 external code list (maintained at x12.org/codes), not medical codes. Each denial ingested from an 835 remittance is classified by its CARC into the check families that should have caught it pre-submission; the gap report then verifies whether the stored result actually flagged the denied code under one of those families. check_families tokens are matched case-insensitively as substrings against claim_scrub filter_ids and validator issue categories.
